maintainer_comments.body:
```suggestion
| `clang-format` CI check fails | `clang-format -i <modified files>` |
```

maintainer_comments.author: hpatro
maintainer_comments.body:
```suggestion
- For large features, open an issue for discussion before submitting a PR.
```

maintainer_comments.author: hpatro
maintainer_comments.body:
Let's use `clang-format`, I believe the symlink should exist to appropriate version.
```suggestion
- After modifying C/C++ files, run: `clang-format -i <modified files>`
```

maintainer_comments.author: hpatro
maintainer_comments.body:
Shall we provide similar `$(nproc)` suggestion like you have done below for CMake ?


```suggestion
make -j$(nproc) BUILD_TLS=yes             # With TLS support
make -j$(nproc) SANITIZER=address         # With AddressSanitizer
```

maintainer_comments.author: hpatro
maintainer_comments.body: Does this help ? Generally the agents are able to discover the right files for me.

maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: I don't think there is strong evidence that layouts help agents. Would consider removing this.

maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body:

maintainer_comments.author: madolson

maintainer_comments.author: madolson

You can't push to the unstable branch, it has branch protections.
```suggestion
```

maintainer_comments.author: hpatro
maintainer_comments.body: Helps avoiding it on the fork where the branch protection isn't active for everyone.

maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: That's not a valkey specific thing though? Again, my opinion is we should include as little as possible that agents can't infer. Agents can infer that you shouldn't push to default branch.

maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: Actually, I now wonder if we need the "never push directly to valkey-io" either, you can't push there either.
